library(tidyverse)

# TRAIN: RISK GRAPH
# departments + shrinkage + stocktake + price

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

# SHRINKAGE RISK

shrinkage <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/shrinkage.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    items_expected = as.numeric(items_expected),
    revenue_expected = as.numeric(revenue_expected),
    items_lost = as.numeric(items_lost),
    revenue_lost = as.numeric(revenue_lost)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(department))

shrinkage_profile <- shrinkage %>%
  mutate(
    item_loss_rate = ifelse(items_expected > 0, items_lost / items_expected, NA_real_),
    revenue_loss_rate = ifelse(revenue_expected > 0, revenue_lost / revenue_expected, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk =
      0.35 * percent_rank(items_lost) +
      0.35 * percent_rank(revenue_lost) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(item_loss_rate) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(revenue_loss_rate)
  ) %>%
  select(department, shrinkage_risk)

# STOCKTAKE RISK

stocktake <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/stocktake_missing.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    item_value = as.numeric(item_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(item_value),
    item_value >= 0
  )

stocktake_profile <- stocktake %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    stocktake_count = n(),
    stocktake_mean_value = mean(item_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stocktake_risk =
      0.50 * percent_rank(stocktake_count) +
      0.50 * percent_rank(stocktake_mean_value)
  ) %>%
  select(department, stocktake_risk)

# ITEM-LEVEL RISK ENRICHMENT


long_risk <- long_data %>%
  left_join(shrinkage_profile, by = "department") %>%
  left_join(stocktake_profile, by = "department") %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk = replace_na(shrinkage_risk, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk = replace_na(stocktake_risk, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# DEPARTMENT PAIRS

basket_depts <- long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    departments = list(sort(unique(department))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pair_counts <- purrr::map_dfr(basket_depts$departments, function(depts) {
  if (length(depts) < 2) {
    return(tibble(dept_1 = integer(), dept_2 = integer()))
  }
  pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
  tibble(
    dept_1 = pairs[, 1],
    dept_2 = pairs[, 2]
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::count(dept_1, dept_2, name = "pair_count")

dept_counts <- basket_depts %>%
  mutate(n_depts = lengths(departments)) %>%
  select(transaction_id, departments) %>%
  unnest_longer(departments, values_to = "department") %>%
  dplyr::count(department, name = "dept_count")

pair_conditional <- pair_counts %>%
  left_join(
    dept_counts %>% rename(dept_1 = department, dept_1_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_1"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    dept_counts %>% rename(dept_2 = department, dept_2_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_2_given_1 = pair_count / dept_1_count,
    p_1_given_2 = pair_count / dept_2_count,
    conditional_strength = (p_2_given_1 + p_1_given_2) / 2,
    conditional_rarity = -log(conditional_strength)
  )

pair_risk <- pair_conditional %>%
  left_join(
    shrinkage_profile %>% rename(dept_1 = department, shrinkage_risk_1 = shrinkage_risk),
    by = "dept_1"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    shrinkage_profile %>% rename(dept_2 = department, shrinkage_risk_2 = shrinkage_risk),
    by = "dept_2"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stocktake_profile %>% rename(dept_1 = department, stocktake_risk_1 = stocktake_risk),
    by = "dept_1"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stocktake_profile %>% rename(dept_2 = department, stocktake_risk_2 = stocktake_risk),
    by = "dept_2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk_1 = replace_na(shrinkage_risk_1, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    shrinkage_risk_2 = replace_na(shrinkage_risk_2, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk_1 = replace_na(stocktake_risk_1, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk_2 = replace_na(stocktake_risk_2, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pair_shrinkage_risk = (shrinkage_risk_1 + shrinkage_risk_2) / 2,
    pair_stocktake_risk = (stocktake_risk_1 + stocktake_risk_2) / 2,
    pair_risk_score = 0.5 * pair_shrinkage_risk + 0.5 * pair_stocktake_risk
  )

# BASKET-LEVEL GRAPH FEATURES

basket_pairs <- basket_depts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pair_tbl = list({
      depts <- departments
      if (length(depts) < 2) {
        tibble(dept_1 = integer(), dept_2 = integer())
      } else {
        pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
        tibble(dept_1 = pairs[, 1], dept_2 = pairs[, 2])
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(transaction_id, pair_tbl) %>%
  unnest(pair_tbl)

basket_pair_features <- basket_pairs %>%
  left_join(
    pair_risk %>%
      select(
        dept_1,
        dept_2,
        conditional_rarity,
        pair_shrinkage_risk,
        pair_stocktake_risk,
        pair_risk_score
      ),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pair_rarity = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pair_rarity = max(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_shrinkage_risk = mean(pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_stocktake_risk = mean(pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_risk_score = mean(pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pair_risk_score = max(pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

item_risk_features <- long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_shrinkage_risk = mean(shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    avg_stocktake_risk = mean(stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(shrinkage_risk >= quantile(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_stocktake_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(stocktake_risk >= quantile(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

risk_graph_train <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(basket_pair_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  left_join(item_risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_pair_rarity = replace_na(mean_pair_rarity, 0),
    max_pair_rarity = replace_na(max_pair_rarity, 0),
    mean_pair_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(mean_pair_shrinkage_risk, median(mean_pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_pair_stocktake_risk = replace_na(mean_pair_stocktake_risk, median(mean_pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_pair_risk_score = replace_na(mean_pair_risk_score, median(mean_pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_pair_risk_score = replace_na(max_pair_risk_score, median(max_pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(avg_shrinkage_risk, median(avg_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, median(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_stocktake_risk = replace_na(avg_stocktake_risk, median(avg_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, median(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, median(high_shrinkage_value_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_stocktake_value_share = replace_na(high_stocktake_value_share, median(high_stocktake_value_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    risk_graph_score =
      0.18 * percent_rank(mean_pair_rarity) +
      0.08 * percent_rank(max_pair_rarity) +
      0.12 * percent_rank(mean_pair_risk_score) +
      0.07 * percent_rank(max_pair_risk_score) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(value_weighted_stocktake_risk) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_shrinkage_value_share) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_stocktake_value_share) +
      0.05 * percent_rank(price_deviation)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(risk_graph_score))

top_150_risk_graph_train <- risk_graph_train %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$avg_price)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$mean_pair_rarity)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$mean_pair_risk_score)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$value_weighted_shrinkage_risk)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_train$value_weighted_stocktake_risk)

write.csv(
  top_150_risk_graph_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_risk_graph_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# CASE37: RISK GRAPH

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# departments + shrinkage + stocktake + price

case37_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case37.csv", warn = FALSE)

case37_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case37_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case37_long <- case37_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case37_basket <- case37_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case37_basket <- case37_basket %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = case37_basket),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

case37_long_risk <- case37_long %>%
  left_join(shrinkage_profile, by = "department") %>%
  left_join(stocktake_profile, by = "department") %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk = replace_na(shrinkage_risk, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk = replace_na(stocktake_risk, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

case37_basket_depts <- case37_long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    departments = list(sort(unique(department))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case37_basket_pairs <- case37_basket_depts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pair_tbl = list({
      depts <- departments
      if (length(depts) < 2) {
        tibble(dept_1 = integer(), dept_2 = integer())
      } else {
        pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
        tibble(dept_1 = pairs[, 1], dept_2 = pairs[, 2])
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(transaction_id, pair_tbl) %>%
  unnest(pair_tbl)

case37_pair_features <- case37_basket_pairs %>%
  left_join(
    pair_risk %>%
      select(
        dept_1,
        dept_2,
        conditional_rarity,
        pair_shrinkage_risk,
        pair_stocktake_risk,
        pair_risk_score
      ),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    conditional_rarity = replace_na(conditional_rarity, max(pair_risk$conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pair_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(pair_shrinkage_risk, median(pair_risk$pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pair_stocktake_risk = replace_na(pair_stocktake_risk, median(pair_risk$pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pair_risk_score = replace_na(pair_risk_score, median(pair_risk$pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pair_rarity = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pair_rarity = max(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_shrinkage_risk = mean(pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_stocktake_risk = mean(pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_risk_score = mean(pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pair_risk_score = max(pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case37_item_risk_features <- case37_long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_shrinkage_risk = mean(shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    avg_stocktake_risk = mean(stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(shrinkage_risk >= quantile(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_stocktake_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(stocktake_risk >= quantile(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

risk_graph_case37 <- case37_basket %>%
  left_join(case37_pair_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  left_join(case37_item_risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_pair_rarity = replace_na(mean_pair_rarity, 0),
    max_pair_rarity = replace_na(max_pair_rarity, 0),
    mean_pair_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(mean_pair_shrinkage_risk, median(mean_pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_pair_stocktake_risk = replace_na(mean_pair_stocktake_risk, median(mean_pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_pair_risk_score = replace_na(mean_pair_risk_score, median(mean_pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_pair_risk_score = replace_na(max_pair_risk_score, median(max_pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(avg_shrinkage_risk, median(avg_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, median(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_stocktake_risk = replace_na(avg_stocktake_risk, median(avg_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, median(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, median(high_shrinkage_value_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_stocktake_value_share = replace_na(high_stocktake_value_share, median(high_stocktake_value_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    risk_graph_score =
      0.18 * percent_rank(mean_pair_rarity) +
      0.08 * percent_rank(max_pair_rarity) +
      0.12 * percent_rank(mean_pair_risk_score) +
      0.07 * percent_rank(max_pair_risk_score) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(value_weighted_stocktake_risk) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_shrinkage_value_share) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_stocktake_value_share) +
      0.05 * percent_rank(price_deviation)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(risk_graph_score))

top_150_risk_graph_case37 <- risk_graph_case37 %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_risk_graph_case37$total_items)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case37$total_price)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case37$avg_price)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case37$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case37$mean_pair_rarity)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_risk_graph_case37$transaction_id))

write.csv(
```

```{r}
risk_graph_train_v_risk <- risk_graph_train %>%
  mutate(
    risk_graph_score_v_risk =
      0.14 * percent_rank(mean_pair_rarity) +
      0.06 * percent_rank(max_pair_rarity) +
      0.14 * percent_rank(mean_pair_risk_score) +
      0.08 * percent_rank(max_pair_risk_score) +
      0.18 * percent_rank(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk) +
      0.18 * percent_rank(value_weighted_stocktake_risk) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_shrinkage_value_share) +
      0.08 * percent_rank(high_stocktake_value_share) +
      0.04 * percent_rank(price_deviation)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(risk_graph_score_v_risk))

top_150_risk_graph_train_v_risk <- risk_graph_train_v_risk %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_risk_graph_train_v_risk$total_items)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# CASE38: VALUE-HEAVY RISK GRAPH

case38_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case38.csv", warn = FALSE)

case38_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case38_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case38_long <- case38_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case38_basket <- case38_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case38_basket <- case38_basket %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = case38_basket),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

case38_long_risk <- case38_long %>%
  left_join(shrinkage_profile, by = "department") %>%
  left_join(stocktake_profile, by = "department") %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk = replace_na(shrinkage_risk, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk = replace_na(stocktake_risk, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

case38_basket_depts <- case38_long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    departments = list(sort(unique(department))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case38_basket_pairs <- case38_basket_depts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pair_tbl = list({
      depts <- departments
      if (length(depts) < 2) {
        tibble(dept_1 = integer(), dept_2 = integer())
      } else {
        pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
        tibble(dept_1 = pairs[, 1], dept_2 = pairs[, 2])
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(transaction_id, pair_tbl) %>%
  unnest(pair_tbl)

case38_pair_features <- case38_basket_pairs %>%
  left_join(
    pair_risk %>%
      select(
        dept_1,
        dept_2,
        conditional_rarity,
        pair_shrinkage_risk,
        pair_stocktake_risk,
        pair_risk_score
      ),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    conditional_rarity = replace_na(conditional_rarity, max(pair_risk$conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pair_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(pair_shrinkage_risk, median(pair_risk$pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pair_stocktake_risk = replace_na(pair_stocktake_risk, median(pair_risk$pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pair_risk_score = replace_na(pair_risk_score, median(pair_risk$pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pair_rarity = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pair_rarity = max(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_shrinkage_risk = mean(pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_stocktake_risk = mean(pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pair_risk_score = mean(pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pair_risk_score = max(pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case38_item_risk_features <- case38_long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_shrinkage_risk = mean(shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    avg_stocktake_risk = mean(stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(shrinkage_risk >= quantile(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_stocktake_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(stocktake_risk >= quantile(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

risk_graph_case38 <- case38_basket %>%
  left_join(case38_pair_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  left_join(case38_item_risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_pair_rarity = replace_na(mean_pair_rarity, 0),
    max_pair_rarity = replace_na(max_pair_rarity, 0),
    mean_pair_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(mean_pair_shrinkage_risk, median(mean_pair_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_pair_stocktake_risk = replace_na(mean_pair_stocktake_risk, median(mean_pair_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_pair_risk_score = replace_na(mean_pair_risk_score, median(mean_pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_pair_risk_score = replace_na(max_pair_risk_score, median(max_pair_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(avg_shrinkage_risk, median(avg_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, median(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_stocktake_risk = replace_na(avg_stocktake_risk, median(avg_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, median(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, median(high_shrinkage_value_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_stocktake_value_share = replace_na(high_stocktake_value_share, median(high_stocktake_value_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    risk_graph_score_v_value =
      0.14 * percent_rank(mean_pair_rarity) +
      0.06 * percent_rank(max_pair_rarity) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(mean_pair_risk_score) +
      0.06 * percent_rank(max_pair_risk_score) +
      0.16 * percent_rank(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk) +
      0.16 * percent_rank(value_weighted_stocktake_risk) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_shrinkage_value_share) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_stocktake_value_share) +
      0.12 * percent_rank(price_deviation)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(risk_graph_score_v_value))

top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value <- risk_graph_case38 %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$total_items)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$total_price)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$avg_price)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$mean_pair_rarity)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$mean_pair_risk_score)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$value_weighted_shrinkage_risk)
summary(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$value_weighted_stocktake_risk)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_risk_graph_case38_v_value.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
